review.verdict: Parse 94 average, and ninth was the best place you managed
review.summary: The parses came in, and they're good: 98 on Ebonroc, 97 on Chromaggus and Nefarian, 94 average against your usual 85. The places didn't get the memo: 19th on Razorgore, 17th on Flamegor and Nefarian, 16th on Chromaggus, with ninth on Ebonroc the best of the night. On Nefarian you also took two Shadow Flames and got feared twice.
